Mixer 6 Connected Speech Word-Initial Stop Consonant Data

Source: R/data.R
mixer6.Rd

Word-initial stop consonant acoustic measurements from connected speech productions across 180 native US English speakers in the Mixer 6 corpus (Chodroff and Wilson 2018) . Contains annotations for voice onset time (VOT), fundamental frequency (f0 in Hz and talker-mean-centered semitones), vowel duration, word duration, and speaking rate.

Usage

data(mixer6)

Format

A tibble with 96,357 rows and 21 variables:

speaker

Speaker identifier as a factor.

sex

Speaker sex as a factor with levels "female" and "male".

stop

Standardized Unicode IPA stop consonant category in phonemic slashes as a factor with 6 levels: /b/, /p/, /d/, /t/, /g/, /k/.

stop_poa

Place of articulation as a factor with levels "labial", "coronal", and "dorsal".

voicing

Phonological voicing as a factor with levels "voiced" and "voiceless".

word

Produced word string.

vowel

Following vowel context in ARPABET notation (e.g., "EH1", "IY1").

trial

Trial number within recording session.

filename

Audio recording filename.

start

Start timestamp in seconds.

end

End timestamp in seconds.

f0

Fundamental frequency at vowel onset in Hertz (Hz).

f0_semitones

Talker-mean-centered fundamental frequency in semitones: \(12 \times \log_2(f_0 / \bar{f}_{0,\text{speaker}})\).

vot

Voice onset time in milliseconds (ms).

vowel_duration

Following vowel duration in milliseconds (ms).

word_duration

Word duration in milliseconds (ms).

speech_rate

Speaking rate in syllables per second.

pos

Utterance position ("utt_init", "utt_mid").

syll

Syllable count category ("one", "two", "more").

type

Word type category ("lex" for lexical/content, "func" for function).

session

Session number.

Source

Mixer 6 corpus via Eleanor Chodroff's OSF repository (https://osf.io/jt5mc/).

References

Chodroff E, Wilson C (2018). “Predictability of stop consonant phonetics across talkers: Between-category and within-category dependencies among cues for place and voice.” Linguistics Vanguard, 4(s2), 20170047.

See also

h95, pb52, swehvd

Examples

data(mixer6)
head(mixer6)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 21
#>   speaker sex    stop  stop_poa voicing word  vowel trial filename  start    end
#>   <fct>   <fct>  <fct> <fct>    <fct>   <chr> <chr> <int> <chr>     <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 111138  female /b/   labial   voiced  BENE… EH1       1 111138_…   4.43   4.44
#> 2 111138  female /b/   labial   voiced  BEING IY1       2 111138_…   4.95   4.96
#> 3 111138  female /b/   labial   voiced  BY    AY1      37 111138_… 154.   154.  
#> 4 111138  female /b/   labial   voiced  BUSH  UH1     129 111138_… 563.   563.  
#> 5 111138  female /b/   labial   voiced  BACK  AE1     130 111138_… 575.   575.  
#> 6 111138  female /b/   labial   voiced  BE    IY0     218 111138_… 871.   871.  
#> # ℹ 10 more variables: f0 <dbl>, f0_semitones <dbl>, vot <dbl>,
#> #   vowel_duration <dbl>, word_duration <dbl>, speech_rate <dbl>, pos <chr>,
#> #   syll <chr>, type <chr>, session <int>
table(mixer6$stop, mixer6$voicing)
